thread:
natalie: Heads-up: SOC wants a concise "playbook-lite" for requesting SIEM exports older than 30 days. Focus scope: forensic investigations only. Need ticket template + unwrap flow.

raj: Are we doing manual unwraps or using the KMUX proxy with ephemeral tokens?

emma: Use KMUX + ephemeral unwrap tokens. High level: request -> approval -> gms-grant issues unwrap token (TTL) -> export to temp bucket -> access granted via ephemeral role.

emma: Quick ticket template suggestion:
```
requestor: <name/email>
case_id: <INV-####>
justification: <why>
time_range: <start,end>
data_classes: <audit/auth/conn>
retention_days: <14|30|...>
kms_key: <logs-cmk>
scrub_required: <yes/no>
approvers: <oncall_sec, sec_mgr>
expiry_ts: <UTC>
```

taylor: Temp S3 buckets must use SSE-KMS with the same CMK, bucket policy denies non-ephemeral principals, lifecycle rule to delete after retention_days. Default snapshot TTL = 14 days.

ops-bot: audit:export_requested case=INV-2091 by=natalie

security-analyst: For DLP: automated redact pipeline for routine exports, manual SOC scrub for high-sev incidents. Add checklist item in ticket for which path.

emma: Emergency/"breakglass" path: two-person auth (requestor + oncall) allowed, but require retro review by CISO or delegate within 24h. Flag the CMK usage in audit logs if breakglass used.

raj: Implementation notes I will add to the KMS policy PR: example gms-grant call: `gms-grant --principal=sec:siem_export --key=logs-cmk --ttl=2h --reason="INV-2091"` and we log grant_id in ticket.

natalie: Action items: emma drafts playbook + ticket template; taylor prepares bucket template; raj updates KMS policy snippets; sec-analyst updates DLP checklist. Target: EOD Friday.

ops-bot: reminder set: playbook-review @emma @taylor @raj due=1736737600

natalie: Thanks — post PRs in #eng-security for quick review. :thumbsup:
